implementation.provider: After a vetoed local textarea proposal, a changed focused canonical model completes the original NSTextView scrollRangeToVisible method. Unchanged cancellation clears the pending reveal; unrelated programmatic changes do not inherit it. No UI/layout/scroll calculation or API extension.
implementation.firefox: Keep the live owned image and cached clip geometry during reentrant engine pre-edit callbacks. Avoid rebinding an intentionally busy native editor. Post-key canonical sync echoes the native viewport through the existing Gecko scroll setter.
implementation.chromium: Keep native geometry/read-only image during reentrant Blink callbacks, then return the post-key native viewport through the existing engine setter after canonical model sync.
implementation.coordinates: Use original LocalFrameView::ConvertFromRootFrame with the element client quads. The previous RootFrameToDocument incorrectly added the page scroll to native-local pointer input. Exact call bytes guarded; no copied coordinate/scroll algorithm.
implementation.scope: Exact pinned unchanged Debian ARM64 Chromium and Firefox, software/headless Wayland, 100 percent scale. Native default vertical/wrapped textareas; opt-in, not installed as the desktop default.

remaining: Pointer autoscroll and ancestor-page caret reveal; richer edits and asynchronous clipboard/menu commands; selection-direction metadata.
IME, accessibility, native scaling/HiDPI, horizontal/nowrap/rich text, broader styling and remaining browser frontend controls.
Root-document integration, other browser builds/derivatives, installed desktop deployment, then GTK/Qt/KDE and other non-GNUstep applications.
input_scope: Real compositor-seat keys in both browser families; paced per-key and rapid-burst comparisons with public NativeUI key-driven native references. Trusted engine events and complete RGB images after deliberate blur, across host replacement. Wheel regressions include six physical-seat full/fractional cases per family. Pointer regression uses explicit-coordinate CDP input and an actual native click reference at page scrollY 60.
variant_scope: Both adapters candidate 02 supply the core/extended/rapid caret checks. Chromium candidate 03 changes only guarded engine pointer-coordinate conversion; its final checks cover 38 viewport/pointer/image assertions, 18 actual-seat editing checks and ten insertion/recovery assertions. The exact adapter is recorded per check group; no broad derivative/build claim.
binary_boundary: Browsers/libxul, installed AppKit and private Wayland backend unchanged. Small adapters and provider rebuilt. Loader binary unchanged; legacy forwarding shim rebuilt from unchanged source. No public C API, ABI, capability or protocol extension.
automation_cleanup: Both owned agent-browser sessions closed before browser teardown. Task CDP forwards 9952/9248 and 9953/9250 cancelled; native-host GDB detached. All eight owned fixtures report no live processes; final session exits normally.

retained_failures.missing_echo: Firefox initially moved selection to position 310 after forty Down keys but kept viewport zero instead of native 491.
retained_failures.external_edit: Filtered local insert bypasses native didChangeText/reveal. Provider-only completion passed direct tests but the browser discarded the busy editor during reentrant layout; retain it until the canonical model returns.
retained_failures.pointer: Trusted Chromium page coordinates (52,255) on a page scrolled by 24 became native local y=137 instead of 113 due to RootFrameToDocument. Corrected original frame conversion passes explicit scroll-60 reference checks.
retained_failures.fixture: Wait for canonical default handling, not only keydown; preserve page scroll on blur; keep whole controls visible in pixel comparisons; serialize unchanged long native values once instead of overflowing the fixture reply.
retained_failures.resource: Host low disk and a stalled old SSH master disrupted one startup. Fresh connection proved VM responsive; failed fixtures cleaned their trees. User-authorized removal of retired temporary backups restored about 27 GiB free, preserving source/evidence/VM.
